svg.title: The PUG rating ladder
svg.desc: Ten ranks from Rookie to Legend, set per season by staff: Rookie <750, Prospect 750+, Contender 850+, Challenger 950+, Pro 1050+, Elite 1150+, Star 1250+, All-Star 1350+, Superstar 1500+, Legend 1650+. Ranks are Discord roles and change the moment your rating crosses a threshold.
